<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1347">
<div class="grid">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12">Vacation Homes in the Dune Park on Fehmarn</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12">The Best Place to Stay on the Baltic Sea Coast for Golf Fans</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-10 block">
<p>Located right next to the Kurzloch Golf Course and just a few meters from the first tee at Golfpark Fehmarn, our high-quality vacation homes in D&uuml;nenpark can accommodate 4 or 5 people. Take all the space you need: 70 square meters in a detached home or, alternatively, a 35-square-meter half of a duplex. In either case, you can expect 5- or 4-star comfort, a fresh, coastal decor style, cozy box-spring beds, and a covered patio with an electric awning. By the way: As a guest of the vacation homes, you can, of course, take advantage of all the amenities the vacation park has to offer.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12 block">
<h3>Features of the Seem&ouml;we model:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Combined living room/kitchen with dining area</li>
<li>Two bedrooms with 2.00-meter box-spring beds and a children's bunk bed</li>
<li>Bathroom with shower and toilet</li>
<li>Dishwasher, glass-ceramic stove, and microwave; refrigerator with freezer compartment</li>
<li>TV (additional TV in the master bedroom) and stereo system, safe</li>
<li>With its own parking space</li>
<li>Basic Wi-Fi connection, free of charge</li>
<li>Partially covered patio with an electric awning and patio furniture</li>
<li>Dogs are not allowed</li>
</ul>
</div>

<section class="mod_article section-primary grass-dark block" id="article-1392">
<div class="grid-center">
<div class="col-12_lg-6"><div class="text-box orange grid">
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12 headline-border">Are you traveling with young children?</h2>
<div class="ce_text block">
<p>Then relax: Book our Toddler Carefree Package when you make your reservation, and we&rsquo;ll be happy to provide a crib or high chair, for example. And we can also help you enjoy a free evening together. Ask about our babysitting service, which includes one-on-one care right in your vacation home.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
